caseStudies.title: Pyscle
caseStudies.problem: Outdated Shopify theme with poor mobile experience, no dynamic pricing, and limited customization options — making the store hard to manage and less effective for conversions.
caseStudies.solution: Revamped the Shopify theme with responsive design, added dynamic pricing, and made the store fully customizable without developer intervention.
caseStudies.result: Faster, smoother store with significantly improved mobile UX and better product presentation — measurable improvement in session duration.

caseStudies.title: Mustdulce
caseStudies.problem: No existing website, no online presence, and no structured way to attract customers in a competitive local market.
caseStudies.solution: Built the website from scratch with strong on-page SEO, structured content, and lead capture to drive organic traffic and direct inquiries.
caseStudies.result: Consistent customer inquiries from organic search within 3 months of launch. A strong online presence generating real business leads.

caseStudies.title: Eden QR
caseStudies.problem: The platform was half-built with major bugs and incomplete features, making it unstable and not launchable. There was no clear structure to deliver a usable product.
caseStudies.solution: We took over the incomplete project, completed the entire system, fixed critical bugs, and refined all functionality. Ensured the platform was stable, scalable, and ready for real users.
caseStudies.result: Successfully launched a fully functional digital memorial platform with QR-based memory pages. Users can now preserve and share memories of loved ones.
